description: Every X6 xDrive40i is different. That's why we offer the right solution for your engine, your car and your budget.

cards.title: REBUILDING YOUR X6 xDrive40i ENGINE
cards.body: We rebuild your existing X6 xDrive40i engine – strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace all worn or damaged components with updated OEM parts (timing chains, guides & tensioners on the N47). Near-new performance with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: RECONDITIONED X6 xDrive40i ENGINES
cards.body: A full strip-down, inspection and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.

cards.title: REFURBISHED X6 xDrive40i ENGINES
cards.body: Restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild service covers this.

cards.title: REMANUFACTURED X6 xDrive40i ENGINES
cards.body: Built to original specification with updated components. That's exactly what our rebuild service delivers on both the N47 and B47.

cards.title: REPLACEMENT X6 xDrive40i ENGINES
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we offer complete engine replacement and fitting – sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month warranty.

cards.title: USED X6 xDrive40i ENGINES
cards.body: Matched low-mileage used engines for when time is critical. We source and fit these too, but most owners choose a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risks.

banner.title: NOT SURE WHICH OPTION IS RIGHT FOR YOU?
banner.body: Enter your registration below and we'll confirm your engine (N47 or B47) and talk you through the best solution for your X6 xDrive40i.
